title: Helm — Free Bootstrap 6 Admin Dashboard Template
excerpt: A free eight-page Bootstrap 6 admin dashboard — collapsible sidebar, SVG charts with no chart library, selectable data tables, a full form set, profile, tabbed settings, sign-in and 404.
yoastTitle: Helm — Free Bootstrap 6 Admin Dashboard Template
yoastDesc: Free Bootstrap 6 admin dashboard template with a collapsible sidebar, hand-built SVG and CSS charts, selectable data tables with bulk actions, Combobox and Datepicker forms, OTP and password strength, tabbed settings, sign-in and 404 pages. No chart library, no build step.
intro: Helm is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 admin dashboard template for SaaS back-offices, internal tools, e-commerce administration and analytics panels. Eight pages — overview, analytics, orders, forms, profile, settings, sign-in and 404 — sharing one shell with a sidebar that collapses to an icon rail and becomes a Drawer on phones.
note: There is no chart library. The line and area charts are inline SVG, the bar charts are flex rows, and the donut is a single conic-gradient — because a dashboard template that depends on Chart.js is really a Chart.js template, and the first thing most people do is swap it for whatever their stack already uses. Everything else leans on components that genuinely did not exist in Bootstrap 5: the mobile navigation is a native <dialog> Drawer, the forms page exercises Combobox, Datepicker, the OTP input and the password Strength meter, and the orders table uses the new .table-stacked so it reflows to labelled blocks on a phone rather than scrolling sideways.
summary: Helm is a free, premium eight-page Bootstrap 6 admin dashboard. The overview pairs stat tiles with an SVG revenue chart, a conic-gradient conversion donut, a weekday bar chart and a recent-orders table. Analytics adds a sessions chart, an acquisition breakdown built from progress bars and a top-pages table. Orders is a searchable, selectable table with an indeterminate select-all and a bulk-action bar. Forms covers every Bootstrap 6 control including Combobox, Datepicker, OTP, password strength and range. Profile, tabbed settings with a static destructive dialog, sign-in and 404 complete the set. The sidebar collapses to an icon rail and remembers the choice; on phones it becomes a Drawer. No chart library, no build step, ESM-only vanilla JavaScript, full light and dark mode.
